gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histological diagnosis of primary, newly diagnosed supratentorial, WHO grade IV glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: 18F-Fluciclovine is an FDA-approved radioactive diagnostic agent that is injected into the patient and then taken up by cancer cells, which can then be visualized with a PET/CT scan.

To assess whether incorporating fluciclovine PET into radiotherapy planning significantly changes the in-field and out-of-field radiographic progression rates, by comparison to traditional MRI-based radiotherapy

coder_notes: Radiotherapy-planning imaging trial: 18F-fluciclovine is a PET tracer used to define radiotherapy target volumes (diagnostic_agent); no pharmacological antitumour candidate. Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but all patients plan standard XRT + TMZ (soc_backbone). Population 'WHO grade IV glioma' without IDH requirement = historical glioblastoma; conditions name glioblastoma. Registered NO_INTERVENTION arm is the control; no OTHER/EXPERIMENTAL arm acts as control.
